Fig. 1. Bioinformatic analysis of pgm gene cluster. (A) Simplified schematic of pgm gene cluster. Core genes are in colour. (B) Putative functions and homologs of the

figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Phenotypic characterization of sTF activation mutants. (A) Colony phenotype on AMM plates and photographs of cultures in LPM medium. (B) HPLC profiles 
with UV 250 nm of culture extracts. 1–3 denote the newly detected metabolites. (C) Structures of compounds representing the numbered peaks in the HPLC profile.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Colour comparison and surface structure analysis of conidia. Scanning electron microscopic (SEM) pictures of detailed surface structure of single conidia. The 
right panel shows a transmission electron microscopic (TEM).

figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Identification of the gene cluster pgm under pgmR expression control. (A) Comparison of the transcription levels of ATEG_06200-ATEG_06214 in the parental 
and pgmR overexpressing strain by semiquantitative RT-PCR. (B) Metabolic profiles of individual gene deletion mutants (the asterisks represent an unrelated 
background compound).
